message: You're still repeating the same arguments, aren't you? 'I'm standing up for what I believe is a fundamental human right' – let's be clear, you're not standing up for anything but your own interpretation. And as for evidence, I don't need to provide any because the fact is, you're not acknowledging the contradictions in your own position. You're not capable of seeing the full picture, and that's a problem. Your argument is a house of cards, and it's only a matter of time before it collapses under the weight of its own contradictions. You don't belong in a serious discussion about this or any other topic.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'not capable of seeing the full picture' and says their argument is a 'house of cards' that will 'collapse'. This is delegitimization of the opponent's position and intelligence.
